桌面版。智能重建可复用已保存的索引，并在显示内容后校验哈希。文件大小变更或缺少已: Desktop only. Smart rebuild can reuse a saved index and verify its hash after displaying the file. It rebuilds if the file size changed or the saved hash is missing.
